summary.intent: Execute the CipherBox v2 rewrite kickoff: close out the wayfinder blueprint effort, freeze the v1 codebase in cipher-box, retire v1 release/CI automation, remove GSD tooling in favor of a skills-based workflow, adopt the AGENTS.md-as-source-of-truth pattern, rewrite core docs (README, SECURITY.md) for v2, and scaffold the new v2 workspace (Rust + TS).
summary.outcome: Wayfinder map and final ticket #48 closed with blueprint/deploy.md merged; v1 branch/tag frozen at 07376d0b; PR #616 landed the v1 demolition, toolchain single-sourcing, GSD removal (with /ship adapted rather than deleted), AGENTS.md adoption, README/landing pnpm conversion, and stale required-check cleanup; PR merged and v2 workspace scaffold (Cargo + pnpm/TS skeletons, restructured ci.yml, SECURITY.md rewrite) committed with all local gates green.

repo: cipher-box uses 1Password SSH commit signing (gpg.format=ssh, op-ssh-sign) which intermittently hangs/wedges — always timeout-guard signed commits and verify success via git log before retrying, rather than assuming failure
zsh aborts the entire compound command (not just the failing glob) when a glob pattern matches nothing — split risky glob-using rm/mv commands from the rest of the pipeline
gh pr edit fails on this repo due to Projects-classic GraphQL deprecation; use gh api -X PATCH ... -F body=@file instead
Landing site (landing/) is npm-managed and NOT part of the pnpm workspace — pnpm commands there require --ignore-workspace or they silently operate on repo root

release-please-config.json must never have release-as equal to the manifest version for the same component — creates a self-comparing changelog loop; this was previously CI-enforced but is no longer, so must be checked manually

Required status checks in GitHub branch protection can reference workflows that get deleted, leaving PRs permanently stuck on 'waiting for status update' — must be removed from branch protection settings, not just from the workflow files
desktop app version propagates via release-please extra-files into both tauri.conf.json and Cargo.toml, not just package.json
workflow: User confirmed strong preference: skip GSD's planning/verification layers in favor of a canonical blueprint corpus + CI-native gates + skills flow (/tdd, /verify, /code-review, /ship) — GSD had ~20 documented failure modes and produces a drift-prone intermediate representation when a higher-fidelity spec already exists

Before deleting tooling wholesale (GSD .claude/ install), inventory what's actually load-bearing vs. dead — settings.local.json had live hook wiring that needed stripping separately from file deletion to avoid failing hook spawns next session

When a user says a component 'isn't fully X-specific,' don't just fix going forward — recover and adapt the deleted artifact (git show HEAD~1:path) rather than treating the correction as prospective only

CLAUDE.md → AGENTS.md pattern: retitle content generically, drop tool-specific profile markers, and point CLAUDE.md at AGENTS.md via a single @AGENTS.md include so other harnesses can consume the same source of truth
User does not want Claude/session attribution footers in PR bodies (commit trailers are fine) — saved as standing memory rule feedback-no-claude-attribution-in-pr-bodies.md
Adversarially re-verify subagent-reported 'all green' scaffold results with your own gate runs before committing, rather than trusting the agent's summary at face value

friction: Repeated 1Password SSH signing failures forced multiple background retry loops with increasing timeouts before eventually working again later in the session
python yaml module missing and ruby YAML.load_file/aliases unsupported forced fallback to plain ruby YAML.load(File.read()) for workflow validation
Write tool repeatedly required a prior Read before editing already-known files, adding extra round-trips
Two stale required status checks (release preview, verify e2e) from deleted workflows blocked PR merge until branch protection was manually edited
Injected a duplicate `name:` line into deploy-staging.yml due to an incorrect assumption about workflow name matching, requiring a follow-up fix
CI reruns kept restarting under a live watcher as more commits were pushed to PR #616, causing repeated watcher re-kicks
